name: The Westbury Dublin
positioning: Five-star hotel on Balfe Street in central Dublin, owned by the Irish family-owned Doyle Collection, with an art-filled Gallery for Afternoon Tea, a 1930s-style cocktail bar and two restaurants
best_for: Travelers who want a central Dublin base on Balfe Street
Food and drink lovers who want fine dining, an all-day brasserie and a cocktail bar under one roof
Guests who enjoy Afternoon Tea surrounded by an art collection

facts.text: The Westbury is a member of Leading Hotels of the World.
The hotel's address is Balfe Street, Dublin 2.
The Westbury is owned and managed by The Doyle Collection, an Irish family-owned luxury hotel group with hotels in Dublin, London, Washington DC and Cork.
Guests arrive by ascending the hotel's central staircase.
Guest rooms and suites showcase Irish and international design.
Balfes is an all-day bar and restaurant combining the energy of a New York eatery with the relaxed elegance of a Parisian brasserie.
The P.V. Doyle Suite honours the man who began what became The Doyle Collection and was a pioneer of hospitality in Ireland.
The hotel was voted No.1 hotel in Ireland in the Conde Nast Traveller 2025 Readers' Choice Awards.

highlights.text: WILDE is the hotel's signature fine dining restaurant.
The Sidecar is a modern take on a 1930s cocktail bar.
The Gallery has an art collection and serves Afternoon Tea.

considerations.text: The hotel is in central Dublin, on Balfe Street in Dublin 2.
WhataHotel notes the busy street location may bring some urban noise.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
